summary: Standards/spec fidelity: the CHANGELOG (Unreleased, the data.reports[] bullet) says `meta.schemaVersion` of `evidence add` and `evidence audit` is `1.1` (was `1.0`). The built binary answers `1.2` on every `evidence add --json` write; the 0.39.0 binary answered `1.1` (A/B run, and docs/cli/canon.cli.json moved 1.1 -> 1.2): EvidenceAddReport::SCHEMA_VERSION is 1.1 and json_out::schema_version_of adds one minor for the state members a write carries. A caller that pins the version off the CHANGELOG reads the wrong number. No bound test pins either number (gate.ci-run.13 greps needles; conformance evidence-add-refused-unknown-spec-root carries 1.2). The bump itself (a minor for the additive `reports` member) follows the Report trait rule and the artifacts prune/verify precedent: I agree with it. Fix: write `1.2` (was `1.1`) and pin it in a bound test. Blast radius: the bump reaches every evidence add and evidence audit answer, single-scenario ones too, which the brief never mentions.
